newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Tamboril Cigar Q2 full results.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Tamboril Cigar Q2 full results.

text.p: Tamboril Cigar Co said its net income for the second quarter ended June 30 was $473,003, or $0.08 per share, on sales of $1.8 million.
The company said its net income for the first six months of 1997 was $213,000, or $0.04 per share, on sales of $2.5 million.
The company did not report comparable results because it only completed its initial public offering in November 1996.
The company said it has 5.6 million shares outstanding.
Tamboril owns cigar manufacturing facilities in the Dominican Republic.
